entries.topic: Simon wounded by a guard, no SWAT team: does the roof prompt play
originals: SIMON CAN'T CONTINUE without SWAT?
Simon's roof prompt nested under the SWAT branch?
A Simon wounded by a guard with no SWAT team: built as jumping…
entries.question: On a run with ASSAULT > shoot the guard on the phone (Simon is shot), the server door locked and the operator shot (so no SWAT team), did the roof scene 'Simon can't continue' with LEAVE / KILL appear (yes/no)?
entries.why: The template nests PROMPT 11 only under SWAT storms the room > Help > Save Simon, and the wiki flowchart says 'Simon Can't Continue - if Simon Saved, otherwise Run to Jump'; but PowerPyx says it 'Triggers if Simon was wounded during the mission. Either you chose the ASSAULT option … and shot the guy on phone or …' (and lists the same path under SIMON WAS LEFT BEHIND), the wiki's own note says 'The only way for Simon to escape is by locking the door, incapacitating both guards and shooting the fleeing reporter', and the Simon page says 'If Simon was injured by SWAT and/or security, he is unable to make the jump off the roof'. Against them, the template's left-guard line is Simon's 'I'm okay… I can keep going.' The benchmark has that Simon jump with the group (THE GROUP ESCAPED), which changes Simon's survival into Public Enemy.

entries.topic: Which speech choice drives the news tone line
originals: Public-opinion tone line? (a) Does 'CALM' … mean the opening … or the ending
Which choice 'CALM' means in the tone line?
The tone line's 'CALM': built on the ending (END PEACEFULLY)…
entries.question: With nobody killed, BEGIN CALMLY and END DETERMINEDLY: did Public Opinion go up at Media Reacts (yes/no)? (A 'no' means the ending drives the tone line, as built.)
entries.why: Template tone condition reads 'Chose CALM and didn't kill anyone' (CALM is the opening's label, PROMPT 5) and 'Chose DETERMINED or killed humans' (a label on both PROMPT 5 and 9); the wiki chapter page and Public_Opinion tie it to 'the "peaceful" option at the end of the speech'; PowerPyx needs 'the calm start & peaceful ending'. The benchmark keys it on the ending (M12). Worth ±2 public opinion either way.

entries.topic: DETERMINED ending with no casualties: size of the drop
originals: DETERMINED ending with no casualties is a large down?
DETERMINED with no deaths: built as the template's −2; the wiki says −1?
entries.answer: Large down: the template's tone line gives PublicOpinion LargeDown for 'Chose DETERMINED or killed humans' (an ordinary arrow; the reliability log has no template error of this kind); the wiki's small down is outranked.
entries.source: dbt template Media Reacts, second CONDITION GROUP; wiki Public Opinion list

entries.topic: Casualties: size of the drop, and 'kill everyone'
originals: 'If you kill everyone' (Public_Opinion, Large Decrease)?
Killing a guard and the operator is a small down?
entries.answer: The casualty line is a small down for one or two casualties ('Killed a guard and the operator' SmallDown, as Public_Opinion's 'one or two casualties'); the large decrease for killing people is the tone line's 'Chose DETERMINED or killed humans' LargeDown, which the benchmark applies whenever anyone was killed (M14m).
entries.source: dbt template Media Reacts, both CONDITION GROUPs; wiki Public_Opinion lines 45 and 55–56

entries.answer: Jericho SmallUp on choosing ASSAULT; 'Shoot the left guard' adds Jericho SmallDown and Simon SmallDown; the right guard has no arrow. Net 0 Jericho on the left-guard path. Ordinary arrows, template outranks the wiki's placement.

originals: North ▼ on an unlocked door?
North −1 on DRAW GUN with the employee…
entries.question: With the server door unlocked, when you chose DRAW GUN and Markus knocked the employee out himself, did a North ↓ popup appear (yes/no)?
entries.why: The template puts ARROW North SmallDown at the top of the whole 'IF: Didn't lock the door' block (before PROMPT 2); the wiki chapter page lists it as 'Forgetting to lock the door and North stuns the employee' and a wiki note says explicitly that if Markus 'incapacitates the employee himself, then his relationship with North will not decrease'. The benchmark applies −1 on all three options (M10e).

entries.topic: Guard choice is the player's, not a roll
originals: Which guard is a choice, not a roll?

entries.answer: A choice: the template's conditions 'Shoot the right guard' / 'Shoot the left guard'; PowerPyx: shoot the left guard with L1 or the right with R1. M10b offers both.
entries.source: dbt template PROMPT 3 ASSAULT; pp.txt 'Shoot Guard on Phone' / 'Shoot Guard Drawing Weapon'
